subject: Re: BlueFin - SSO/SCIM onboarding & access guardrails
messages:
From: Jack Tan <jack.tan@bluefinsec.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BlueFin - SSO/SCIM onboarding & access guardrails

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — BlueFin is excited to move forward. Our security team wants to validate the SSO and SCIM integration plan and confirm network constraints (IP allowlist) before we hand this over to production. High level asks:

- SAML SSO (IdP initiated & SP initiated) — we need ACS/EntityID and metadata.
- SCIM provisioning (user + group sync) — mapping for role_attribute, externalId, and deprovisioning behavior.
- Service account model for API-based provisioning and where secrets are stored.
- IP allowlist ranges & what components need egress from our VPC.

Can you send a short checklist and propose a two-week timeline for pilot -> prod? Also possible to share your SOC2 artifact that describes audit logging for user provisioning?

Regards,
Jack
Director, IT Operations
BlueFin Financial

P.S. cc'ing our security PM Sara Lopez who will own technical validation.

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jack Tan <jack.tan@bluefinsec.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@bluefinsec.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin - SSO/SCIM onboarding & access guardrails

Jack — great to hear, glad the demo landed. Attaching a brief checklist and the MAT (mutual action plan) to get this started. TL;DR below and we can sync with your security team this afternoon if that works.

Quick checklist (pilot -> prod):
1) Exchange SAML metadata (we provide SP metadata; you provide IdP metadata).
2) SCIM schema confirmation — attribute mapping and group behavior (we support urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User plus custom role attribute).
3) Create a Redwood service account for provisioning with key rotation cadence (we support short-lived API keys via our enterprise KMS integration).
4) IP allowlist & egress — confirm CIDR blocks for control plane and runtime (we'll provide a minimal list).
5) Audit & retention — we will provide provisioning audit logs (showing user create/update/delete) and retention windows.

Requested timeline: pilot (1 week test SCIM + SSO in staging), validation (3 days), production cutover (1 day). I'll loop in Karthik for SCIM specifics and Monica for CS coordination.

Olga Petrov
Manager, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, bluefin_scim_requirements.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jack Tan <jack.tan@bluefinsec.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@bluefinsec.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin - SSO/SCIM onboarding & access guardrails

Jack / team — quick technical notes from the infra side (posting here so we have a written record):

1) SCIM attributes: we recommend mapping externalId -> employee_id, userName -> email, urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:employeeNumber -> bluefin_employee_number, and we can sync an optional role attribute (redwoodRole) to manage product entitlements. If you want group-based entitlements, send the canonical group IDs.

2) Provisioning behavior: our default is immediate on create, updates applied idempotently, and we send a 1-week grace period for deprovision (we can reduce to 24h on request but that breaks some customer workflows).

3) Service accounts & secrets: we prefer customers to provision a service account in their vault and share a scoped API key via our console. For customers using KMS, we support HSM-backed keys and rotation. If BlueFin requires us to pull from your vault via SP connector, we can schedule engineering time.

4) IP allowlist: please confirm whether you need both control-plane (console/API) and runtime (inference egress) ranges. Minimum control-plane egress: 34.210.12.0/24, 34.210.13.0/24 (example — final list in our network doc). Runtime endpoints vary by region; for US pilot we'll provide exact CIDRs.

5) SAML metadata: I'll attach our sample SP metadata. We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows; if you use signed assertions, please let me know the signature algorithm.

I'll be on the call at 14:00 PT.

— Karthik
Principal Architect, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: saml-metadata-bluefin.xml

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jack Tan <jack.tan@bluefinsec.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@bluefinsec.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin - SSO/SCIM onboarding & access guardrails

Jack / Sara — thanks for the prompt. I've created a mutual action plan with milestones and assigned owners. Proposed pilot schedule:

- Day 0: Exchange metadata + provision staging service account (you)
- Day 1: SCIM mapping verification + test sync (Redwood infra + BlueFin identity)
- Day 2-3: End-to-end SSO flows + provisioning smoke tests (security validation)
- Day 4: Audit log review + retention confirmation
- Day 5: Production cutover window (documented rollback steps)

Please review attached MAP (mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf) and the SCIM requirements sheet. For the kickoff call I propose 14:00 PT today (Olga / Karthik will cover technical items, Ben will join for policy/RBAC questions). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and add a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Note: Ben — BlueFin has a strict org policy around service accounts. They require MFA for console users, RBAC for admin roles, and a 90-day rotation for any long-lived keys. We'll need to surface those constraints to engineering before production.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, bluefin_scim_requirements.xlsx

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@bluefinsec.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jack Tan <jack.tan@bluefinsec.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueFin - SSO/SCIM onboarding & access guardrails

Monica / team — 14:00 PT is confirmed. A few clarifications from our side before the call:

- We will provide IdP metadata (Okta) and want signed assertions with RSA-SHA256.
- Group sync: we will send group ID namespaces prefixed with "bluefin-"; we'd like entitlement mapping to be reversible (so we can audit).
- IP allowlist: control plane only for now, runtime will be handled later. Control-plane egress ranges can be limited to the list you provided; please send final CIDRs in the network doc.
- Audit expectations: retention for 12 months for provisioning events. Can you confirm whether logs include actor, timestamp, action, and source IP?

I will also upload a short security questionnaire to the shared Drive prior to the call. Looking forward to the sync.

— Sara Lopez
Security Program Manager
BlueFin Financial

Attachment stubs: bluefin_security_questionnaire.docx
